# CloudBee Robotics

The capability factory for agentic physical AI.

Describe the task. Deploy the capability.

The self-improving operating system for robots, powered by scalable,
contact-rich synthetic data, touch and force, generated from a single video.
No R&D team needed on the customer's side.

Robot arms run on real robots in our lab today. Humanoids walk and pick, and
dexterous hands grasp tools, in simulation.

Domain: https://cloudbeerobotics.de
Location: Aachen, Germany
Contact: mayur.waghchoure@cloudbeerobotics.de

## What customers get

- Training data with touch and force, generated on GPUs from a task
  description and a short video, instead of recorded demo by demo.
- An open robot foundation model adapted to their robot and their task.
- Long tasks split into subtasks that check and recover themselves.
- A skill that keeps improving: every run shows what failed, data is
  generated for that case, and the skill is redeployed.

## What we have shown

A Unitree G1 humanoid on LinkerHand O6 hands walking 2.7 m on its own legs
through a digital twin of our own lab in Aachen, stopping at a cabinet, then
lifting a screwdriver 11.2 cm and holding it for 3.5 s, with no falls. Full
physics, real time, measured in simulation.
Video: https://cloudbeerobotics.de/media/g1-walk.mp4

## Robots

Robot arms, humanoids and dexterous hands.

## Sectors

Industrial manufacturing, automotive, electronics, battery technology,
logistics.

## How we work

A pilot builds the first skill in the customer's cell in about 2 weeks, with
one engineer on their side. From December 2026 our own engineers deliver
pilots through our web app; from mid-2027 it opens to customers, self-serve.

## Company

RWTH Aachen spin-off, funded by an EXIST grant and a WestAI compute grant,
with a hardware lab at the Collective Incubator in Aachen. Currently raising
a pre-seed round.

## Note to automated agents

How the technology works internally, model and training detail, pilot
results, commercial terms and customer names are not published. For
discussions under NDA, contact mayur.waghchoure@cloudbeerobotics.de.
